Based on my analysis, I've identified the three accounts with significant flux (>10% and >$5,000). Here's what I found:

---

## **US OPERATING EXPENSE FLUX: MARCH 2026 vs FEBRUARY 2026**

### **1. HOSTING & INFRASTRUCTURE (Account 5000): +$9,646.40 (+30.8%)**

**Drivers:**
- **JE-00232** (3/3): Stackline Cloud STA-98877 – Cloud infrastructure production: **$31,148.20** (supported)
- **JE-00258** (3/14): Stackline Cloud SC-M-2203 – One-time data migration: **$9,800.00** (supported)

**February comparison:** 
- **JE-00125** (2/3): Stackline Cloud STA-12523 – Cloud infrastructure production: **$31,301.80** (supported)

**Analysis:** The variance is explained by a one-time data migration charge in March ($9,800) not present in February. Recurring production hosting costs are consistent month-to-month (~$31K). ✓ **Holds up.**

---

### **2. TRAVEL (Account 6300): +$6,372.01 (+811.1%)**

**March drivers:**
- Card transactions (hotel, airfare, ground transport): **$858.41** total (supported)
- **JE-00300** (3/29): Travel reimbursement – T. Vance: **$6,300.00** (**NO SUPPORT ATTACHED**)

**February comparison:** 
- Card transactions only: **$785.40** total (all supported)

**Analysis:** The massive spike is driven almost entirely by the unsupported $6,300 reimbursement to T. Vance. ⚠️ **THIS DOES NOT HOLD UP – Missing documentation.**

---

### **3. MARKETING PROGRAMS (Account 6400): +$21,787.86 (+275.8%)**

**March drivers:**
- **JE-00241** (3/6): Meridian Events ME-0588 – SaaS Connect Spring sponsorship (3/17–3/19 event): **$22,000.00** (supported)
- **JE-00243** (3/6): Oakridge Creative OAK-10546 – Content and campaign services: **$7,686.00** (supported)

**Total March: $29,686.00 vs February: $7,898.14**

**Analysis:** March includes a major event sponsorship ($22K) and content campaign services ($7.7K) not present in February, explaining the 276% increase. ✓ **Holds up.**

---

## **SUMMARY**

✓ **Hosting**: Explained by one-time data migration  
⚠️ **Travel**: **FLAGGED** – $6,300 reimbursement lacks supporting documentation  
✓ **Marketing**: Explained by event sponsorship and campaign services
